data.body: **[P1] Keep read-only filesystem failures terminal.** This fallback still labels every unlisted `IOException` retryable. On Linux, writing to a read-only EFS/base mount commonly raises `FileSystemException` (`EROFS`), not `AccessDeniedException`, so this permanent configuration error requests backend invocation retries indefinitely. Detect read-only/provider configuration failures—such as via `FileStore.isReadOnly()`—as `PayloadOffloadException`, reserve the retryable subtype for known transient failures, and add read-only-provider coverage.
